title: 第七章 大师兄肚子疼？
slug: 傲世九重天全本免费-傲世九重天最新章节列表
content_zh:
“楚师弟，怎么样？”石千山没有发现楚阳有提升的兆头，急忙问道。
不知怎地，一般人在突破的时候，就算是最轻微的反应，浑身气机也总会剧烈波动一下的，但这药力在经过了九劫剑转化之后，竟然突破阶位无声无息……
楚阳眼神平静，心中却是不住思量：这，这可是一个阴人的好手段啊，若是别人都看着我是三级，但实际上却是五级六级七八级……打起架来该多么爽啊。
“貌似不怎么管用……还是武徒三品。而且药力太霸道，控制不住，流失了很多。”楚阳强忍着心中的惊喜，皱着眉头叹了口气，使足了劲才让自己用怅然的声音道：“真是浪费啊，早知我吃了这么没效果，还不如大师兄你吃了多好……”
石千山瞪大了眼睛，眼珠几乎要鼓了出来，张着嘴，“嗬嗬”两声，脸上一阵红一阵白，终于站了起来，脸色很难看的道：“我出去走走。”
嗖的一声走了出去。
“大师兄好像不大舒服……”谈昙两道怪异的眉毛上下一阵抖动，有些狐疑的看着石千山的背影说道：“他怎地了？”
“大师兄这几天貌似很累。”楚阳摸着下巴，深沉的道：“心很累。看他脸色，很可能肚子疼。是不是他每个月那几天来了……”
“哦……大师兄忒操心了；唉，咱们这紫竹园也是，师傅他老人家什么都不管，所有的事都是大师兄的，也难怪他心累。”谈昙的招风耳朵居然上下呼扇了一下，深以为然的道：“的确很辛苦。肚子疼，也是可能的。嗯，楚阳，每个月那几天……是哪几天？我咋不知道大师兄还有这毛病？”
谈昙很好奇地问道。
“这个嘛……等你长大了就知道了。小孩子不要乱打听大人的事情，尤其是成人的事情。懂？”楚阳扳起了脸，一本正经的教训。
谈昙一边高一边低的眉毛跳舞一般抖了几下，以此表示了心中的疑惑，这才悻悻地嘀咕了两句，也不知道说的什么，不说话了。
楚阳眼珠一转，心中却打起了另一个主意。
记得前世石千山曾经在紫竹园无意中发现了一株金血玄参，记得后来他得意洋洋地说起，在后山石崖壁上……
金血玄参虽并不能增加功力，但却能够扩张经脉！而且五十年之上的金血玄参一经服下之后，药力在经脉之中附着，武者之下修为每一次进阶，都能带动着经脉扩宽不少！
不管什么功夫，力量都是在经脉中运行。经脉宽度大了，才能够发挥出更大的力量。同样是武士修为，但经脉宽度不同，两者之间的差距却是不可弥补……
金血玄参虽然只对武者之下修为的人管用。但人的经脉却是就在这段时间里定型；这看似不起眼的作用，却能直接奠定一个人的终生成就！
前世的石千山就是因为金血玄参的缘故，才能在天外楼一众弟子之中脱颖而出……
楚阳摸着下巴，心中在想着：不知那金血玄参现在被石千山发现了没有？若是没有的话，自己不妨采来尝尝滋味啊……
……………………

外面天色还是黑蒙蒙的，楚阳就悄悄的爬了起来。看着对面的床上，谈昙四仰八叉的躺着，非常有节奏的发出抑扬顿挫的鼾声，如同在唱歌一般。暗笑了一下，迅速的穿好衣服，走出门来。
欲成人上人，需吃苦中苦！
自己的资质，并不是绝顶！再者，前世的自己少年时并不如何努力，比同龄人也已经有了不小的差距，若是不付出比别人多一倍的汗水，怎么能获得比别人高一倍的成就！
只是呼吸之间，楚阳就来到了紫竹林外石崖之上，稍稍的站定；两脚与肩同宽，摆了一个身体绝对和谐的姿势，沉寂了一会，便开始了动作！
楚阳的动作很简单，却不容易。两脚生了根一般不动，腿不弯；手臂也静止的下垂。动的只有上身。
头颅慢慢的往左侧过去，然后慢慢地往下弯腰，成直角后，回收；然后往右侧过去；再回收，往前弯下去，随即最后一个动作是往后弯过去。
只这四个动作，然后周而复始。但每一次却又比上一次弯的更厉害一些，一炷香的时间之后，楚阳的身子拉开的弓一般的弯下去，脑袋已经接触到了地面！
这是活动腰！
腰力，乃是全身之中最关键的一环。所以放在首位。

content_en:
"Junior Brother Chu, how are you?" Shi Qianshan didn't notice any signs of Chu Yang's promotion and asked hurriedly.
Somehow, when most people make a breakthrough, even the slightest reaction will cause their whole body's Qi to fluctuate violently. However, after being transformed by the Nine Tribulations Sword, the power of this medicine actually breaks through the level silently...
Chu Yang's eyes were calm, but he couldn't help but think in his heart: This, this is a good trick for a sinister person. If others think that I am level three, but in fact I am level five, six, seven or eight... it would be so cool to start a fight.
"It doesn't seem to be very effective... It's still a third-level martial arts disciple. And the potency of the medicine is too overbearing and I can't control it, so I lost a lot." Chu Yang suppressed the surprise in his heart, frowned and sighed, and tried his best to let himself say in a sad voice: "What a waste. If I had known that it would have no effect if I took it, it would not be as good as if you took it, senior brother..."
Shi Qianshan's eyes widened, almost bulging out. He opened his mouth and said "ho ho" twice. His face turned red and white. He finally stood up and said with an ugly face: "I'm going out for a walk."
He walked out with a whoosh.
"Elder brother seems to be feeling unwell..." Tan Tan's strange eyebrows trembled up and down. He looked at Shi Qianshan's back suspiciously and said, "What's wrong with him?"
"Elder brother seems very tired these days." Chu Yang touched his chin and said deeply: "My heart is very tired. Judging from his face, he probably has a stomachache. Does he come here on those days of the month..."
"Oh... Senior brother is so worried; alas, our Zizhuyuan is the same. Master, he doesn't care about anything. Everything belongs to senior brother. No wonder he is tired." Tan Tan's ears actually flapped up and down, and he said with deep approval: "It is indeed very hard. Stomachache is also possible. Well, Chu Yang, what days are those days of each month...which days are they? Why didn't I know that senior brother still has this problem?"
Tan Tan asked curiously.
"Well... you will know when you grow up. Children should not inquire about adults' affairs, especially adult affairs. Understand?" Chu Yang raised his face and taught him a serious lesson.
Tan Tan's raised and lowered eyebrows twitched a few times like a dance, expressing the doubts in his heart. Then he muttered a few words angrily, not knowing what he was talking about, and stopped talking.
Chu Yang rolled his eyes and had another idea in his mind.
I remember that Shi Qianshan accidentally discovered a golden-blooded Scrophulariaceae in Zizhu Garden in his previous life. I remember that later he proudly talked about it, on the stone cliff of the back mountain...
Although Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae cannot increase one's skill, it can expand the meridians! Moreover, once the Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae that has been over fifty years old is taken, the medicinal power is attached to the meridians. Every time the cultivation level of a warrior is advanced, the meridians will be expanded a lot!
No matter what kind of kung fu, power moves through the meridians. The wider the meridians are, the more powerful they can be. Both are warriors, but the width of their meridians is different. The gap between the two is irreparable...
Although Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae is only effective for those who are below the warrior level. But a person’s meridians are shaped during this period; this seemingly inconspicuous effect can directly establish a person’s lifelong achievements!
In his previous life, Shi Qianshan was able to stand out among the disciples of Tianwai Tower because of Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae...
Chu Yang touched his chin, thinking in his mind: I wonder if the Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae has been discovered by Shi Qianshan now? If not, you might as well pick it yourself and taste it...
……………………
It was still dark outside, so Chu Yang got up quietly. Looking at the bed opposite, Tan Tan was lying on his back, snoring very rhythmically, as if he was singing. He smiled secretly, quickly put on his clothes and walked out of the door.
If you want to become a master, you need to endure hardships!
My qualifications are not perfect! Furthermore, I didn’t work very hard when I was a teenager in my previous life, and there was already a big gap compared with my peers. If I don’t work twice as hard as others, how can I achieve twice as much achievement as others!
In just a breath, Chu Yang came to the stone cliff outside the purple bamboo forest and stood still for a moment. With his feet shoulder-width apart, he assumed an absolutely harmonious posture. After a moment of silence, he started to move!
Chu Yang's movements were simple, but not easy. The two feet were rooted and motionless, the legs were not bent, and the arms were still and drooping. Only the upper body moves.
The head slowly moves to the left, then slowly bends down, and after reaching a right angle, it is returned; then it passes to the right; it is returned again, and the head is bent forward, and then the last movement is to bend back.
Just these four actions, and then repeat them over and over again. But each time he bent harder than the last time. After a stick of incense, Chu Yang's body bent like a bow, and his head had already touched the ground!
This is a mobile waist!
Waist strength is the most critical part of the body. So put it first.
